title: Add more `t.Parallel()` to speed up tests
body:
### Proposal

Let's save some time.

- The packages/subdirectories to be checked:
  - [x] `cmd/prometheus`, see https://github.com/prometheus/prometheus/pull/14618
  - [x] `cmd/promtool`, see https://github.com/prometheus/prometheus/pull/15226
  - [x] ~`config/`, Unnecessary, see: https://github.com/prometheus/prometheus/pull/15408~
  - [ ] `discovery/`
    - [x] `kubernetes`, see https://github.com/prometheus/prometheus/pull/15227
  - [x] ~`model/` Unnecessary, see https://github.com/prometheus/prometheus/pull/15349~
  - [ ] `notifier/`
  - [x] `rules/` https://github.com/prometheus/prometheus/pull/17012
  - [x] `scrape/` https://github.com/prometheus/prometheus/pull/17013/files
  - [ ] `storage/`
    - [x] `queue_manager_test.go` https://github.com/prometheus/prometheus/pull/17018 
  - [ ] `tsdb/`
    - [x] `wlog/` https://github.com/prometheus/prometheus/pull/17019
    - [x] `compact`, `db`, `head` https://github.com/prometheus/prometheus/pull/17017/files
  - [ ] `util/`
  - [ ] `web/`, see https://github.com/prometheus/prometheus/pull/15248
  - [ ] `tracing/`
  
  
Note that:
- Some tests may not be designed to run in parallel.
- We should avoid sacrificing test readability (correctness a well of course :)) to make them runnable in parallel.
- Check if subtests can be run in parallel as well.
- If a test runs subtests unofficially (without t.Run()), consider adding the needed wrappers to run the subtests in parallel.
- ~Please make sure to run the tests locally with the race detector enabled (-race) as it's temporarily disabled in the CI.~
- Of course, only make the test run in parallel when it will reduce execution time and not cause other tests to run slower.
-  Let's say it's worthwhile when we can save at least one second (per package), less than that it might just be fluctuation.
- Let's consider the wall-clock time/execution time of the test in the CI as a key reference point for measuring improvements.

Tests can always be run sequentially using`-parallel 1`.
